issues.description: SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber is specified in the UML and text as returning an int (the number of remaining orders). In the solution, SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber is implemented with return type void and instead prints "Order number: ..." lines, so the implemented API/signature and behavior do not match the required return-based method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and expected student implementation) to `public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber()` and return the remaining order count (typically `orders.length`). Move any printing/demo output to Main or a separate method if needed.
